name: Spirit of Silverpine Charts
summary: The Spirit of Silverpine Charts are the ship’s maps, now sought from its wreck in the Arathi Highlands. First Mate Nilzlix wants them secured before the information reaches prying eyes.

sections.title: Aground in the Cove
sections.body: The wreck’s charts are wanted alongside the ship’s log, so First Mate Nilzlix asks you to recover both. The crew says the Spirit of Silverpine ran aground on a temple in the reef when the tides fell. Its charts hold information the crew fears could reach enemy hands, and Fleet Master Seahorn expects them brought back to Booty Bay.

faq.q: What are the Spirit of Silverpine Charts?
faq.answer: They are map charts belonging to the Spirit of Silverpine, a ship wrecked in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Where can I find the charts?
faq.answer: The Spirit of Silverpine Charts are sought from the wreck of the Spirit of Silverpine in the Arathi Highlands.
First Mate Nilzlix wants the charts and logs from the Spirit of Silverpine and the Maiden's Folly recovered.
The crew fears the charts could expose information to prying eyes if left behind.

faq.q: How did the Spirit of Silverpine sink?
faq.answer: The crew says the Spirit of Silverpine ran aground on a temple in the reef when the tides began to lower.

faq.q: Where are the charts being taken?
faq.answer: The recovered charts are meant to be secured for Fleet Master Seahorn and the command in Booty Bay.
